summary: Verified the catalogue PDF bug fix. The floating orange PDF FAB on the home page (WhatsAppFloat) has href='/assets/NutriEdge-Catalogue.pdf?v=20260724b' with download='NutriEdge-Catalogue.pdf' and target='_blank'. Fetched the served bytes from the public preview URL: HTTP 200, Content-Type=application/pdf, Content-Length=3409789 bytes, MD5=68f99535b9356bb8c18b4d6d90ef8ce2 — EXACTLY matches the expected re-uploaded file. context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalogue PDF bug fix verified. Served MD5 == 68f99535b9356bb8c18b4d6d90ef8ce2, size 3409789 bytes. Cache-buster ?v=20260724b present in href. No further action required.
rca of the issue: User complained about downloading a stale/wrong catalogue. RCA: browsers were caching the previous PDF at /assets/NutriEdge-Catalogue.pdf. Fix (already applied by main agent): (1) overwrote the file with the new user-provided PDF, (2) added a cache-buster query string ?v=20260724b to the download URL in mock.js so browsers fetch the new binary. Verified end-to-end on the preview URL.
